column1: # module-renames.tsv: Marketplace modules whose listing was renamed or republished under a new name (BT-6).
# Read by bin/renamed_modules.py (steps/triage.md item 3) and bin/proposal.py (section 3). Matched by CONTENT ID first (a rename keeps
# the id); a module the MPR records without an id is matched by its old name. A row never lists a module that already carries new_name.
# kind RENAMED = same line, new module name, versions continue; REPUBLISHED = new name and the numbering restarts, so it is NOT an update of
# the installed module. Rows come from batch runs (source column); add a row when a run meets another rename, never a guess.
